packs.title: Procedural stand-ins for structures with no open mesh
packs.attribution: No anatomical mesh data; geometric placeholders generated in code, hidden by default and labelled in the interface.

packs.title: Detail pack: Z-Anatomy structures and further HRA objects, fitted to both HRA bodies (skeleton, muscles, vessels, nerves, joints, fascia, organ parts, skin layers)
packs.attribution: Z-Anatomy, the libre 3D atlas of anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0), derived from BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science (CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan; the BodyParts3D site now states CC BY 4.0). Organ parts, spinal cord, patellar ligaments, mammary gland, eye, subcutaneous fat and brain regions: Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Object Library, HuBMAP Consortium (CC BY 4.0), brain regions from the Allen Human Reference Atlas. Registered, decimated and re-encoded by this project; the derived meshes are released under CC BY-SA 4.0. The dermis and hypodermis shells are generated schematics, not anatomy. Excluded: inner ear (CC BY-NC-SA), Z-Anatomy kidney (CC BY-NC), brain and spinal-cord internals of unverified origin.
